headline: Measles outbreak: 11 more deaths reported in 48 hours, toll reaches 1,076
summary: The number of fatalities from the measles outbreak continues to rise, with 11 more deaths recorded in just two days. The cumulative death toll has now surpassed 1,000.
details: The ongoing measles outbreak in the country has claimed 11 more lives in the last 48 hours, bringing the total number of deaths to 1,076. The grim milestone highlights the severity of the public health crisis.

Measles, a highly contagious viral disease, poses a significant threat, particularly to young children who are most vulnerable. The current outbreak has overwhelmed healthcare facilities and strained resources.
Health authorities are urging parents to ensure their children are vaccinated against measles. Vaccination remains the most effective way to prevent the spread of the disease and protect communities.

Efforts are underway to increase vaccination coverage and provide medical care to those affected by the outbreak. However, challenges remain in reaching all vulnerable populations and ensuring access to timely treatment.

headline: Deep depression in Bay: Cautionary signal 3 hoisted at 4 maritime ports
summary: The Meteorological Department warns of squally winds and rain along the coast, with potential impacts reaching Rajshahi and Rangpur divisions.
details: A deep depression over the north-west and west-central Bay of Bengal is threatening rough weather along Bangladesh's coast. The Meteorological Department has warned of squally winds and rainfall in coastal areas.
caption:
